description: Get the best times to post on X based on the user's actual published tweets weighted by engagement (likes, retweets, replies, bookmarks, impressions). Returns a 7×24 day-of-week × hour heatmap, the top 5 windows, and AI-generated insights. If no analysis exists yet, falls back to a frequency-only summary and prompts the user to run analyze.

x_account_id.description: Filter to a specific connected X account (for multi-account users)

name: opentweet_get_best_times
